title: C hal: crc32 + encode_slot/parse_slot helpers for two-slot records (bit-exact with rust lichen-hal storage.rs)
description: First slice of b7z9.11.1 (decompose-first). Pure functions only, no storage I/O: C port of rust/lichen-hal/src/storage.rs crc32 (reflect-8 0xEDB88320, init/max-out) and encode_slot/parse_slot (SLOT_HEADER_LEN 20: magic[4], version u8=1, reserved[3], generation u64 BE nonzero, len u32 BE; payload; crc32 trailer u32 BE). Placement: lichen/subsys/lichen/hal/ (new file, e.g. hal_storage_redundant.c + include header). Tests: new host CTest lichen/tests/hal_storage_redundant pinning a Rust-computed CRC32 vector + encode/parse roundtrip + corrupt/truncated/generation-0/length-mismatch rejects. Update the parent 11.1 description to note this slice done.
close_reason: C port of lichen-hal storage.rs codec layer: crc32 (reflected 0xEDB88320, verified against independent zlib oracle vectors 0x3bddffa4/0x9cefd8c3), encode_slot, parse_slot in lichen/subsys/lichen/hal/hal_storage_redundant.{c,h}; host CTest lichen/tests/hal_storage_redundant covering roundtrip, empty payload, bit-flip, wrong magic, version, reserved, truncation, trailing garbage, lying length, generation 0, small buffer, NULL contract. gcc -Werror, cppcheck clean, ctest green. Reviews via kimi-k3: pass1 correctness — 5 findings, all addressed in-bead (NULL contract completed + documented, header bound doc fixed, 4 test gaps added, stale CMake std-flag workaround deleted now that test_common.cmake probes the compiler); pass2 security PASS; pass3 edge PASS with one very-low-severity encode-boundary divergence vs Rust (>4GiB payload window) — resolved by documenting the intentional stricter C bound in the header. No findings filed as separate beads (all fixed in-scope or documented); the pre-existing CMake NOTFOUND hazard is already tracked as project-LICHEN-worker6-qjdp.
